portal_description:
Buildah provides a command line tool which can be used to:

* create a working container from scratch or
* create a working container from an image as a starting point
* mount/umount a working container's root file system for manipulation
* save container's root file system layer to create a new image
* delete a working container or an image

This updates the rhel8/buildah image in the Red Hat Container Registry.

To pull this container image, run the following command as root:

    podman pull registry.redhat.io/<image_name>
